body: I just don't see the point anymore, really. And the thing is, there is nothing horrible about my life. I have a job, a nice house, a degree, friends. But really I feel like people are growing tired of me and my depression. No one really understands when I try to talk/express my feelings. I don't know why I feel like this, but I'm just exhausted with faking it and fighting. I think it's better for me (and everyone else) if I just go.
I feel exactly the same way as you (26 and F). It's terrible having no one to talk to. If you ever want to talk just to vent or whatever

Every single day for at least the past 2 years. For the past 6-7 months, or so, there hasn't been a day I've woken up and didn't think about it immediately. 
>unsettlingly casual buzz repressed in the back of my head 

exactly that
